name: impeccable
title_zh: 把任何前端界面打磨到无可挑剔的审查与重构技能
tagline_zh: 从落地页到仪表盘，从组件到空状态，它像资深设计合伙人一样揪出视觉层级、信息架构、认知负荷的毛病。
tagline_en: From landing pages to dashboards, it audits visual hierarchy, IA, and cognitive load like a senior design.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. why_zh: 不是泛泛的UI建议，而是逐层拆解界面：先审UX，再调视觉层级，最后动信息架构，每一步都有明确输出。
why_en: It doesn't just give generic UI tips—it deconstructs your interface layer by layer: UX review, visual hierarchy, then IA, with.
limit_zh: 只覆盖前端界面（网页、应用、组件等），不处理后端逻辑、API设计或移动端原生代码。产物是改进建议和重构方案。
limit_en: Only frontend UI (web/app/components); no backend, API, or native mobile. Outputs suggestions, not code. Requires a description or screenshot to.
